result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the horizontal content rows show clipped cards and the fixed bottom navigation appears to cover content near the bottom.

issues.description: The category carousel and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are cut off at the right edge, leaving partial pills and a partially visible restaurant card without an obvious carousel affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scrolling cues such as a fade, partial-card treatment with clear intent, or a next-arrow indicator; ensure the clipping is intentional and consistent.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card, obscuring part of its content and making it appear truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page so cards can be fully viewed above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The first two “Fastest near you” cards appear identical, including the restaurant name, image, delivery time, and delivery fee, which may indicate duplicated content.
issues.suggestion: Verify the carousel data and replace the duplicate card with the correct restaurant or dish.
